evenements.description: A tribute to Buena Vista Social Club performed by Yordan Martinez & The Cuban Martinez Show, with a festive Cuban musical programme. Two packages are offered: the dinner-show formula from $130 per person with a three-course meal and the show, arriving between 17:30 and 19:00; and the show formula from $60 per person, arriving between 19:45 and 20:30 for the 20:30 performance. A VIP experience is available for a $50 per person supplement. Reservations and tickets are available through Le Balcon.
